title: DMT keeps oxygen-deprived neurons alive via the sigma-1 receptor

tellings.quote: >> Um what's interesting is that in a oxygen hypoxic oxygend deprived environment um neurons will survive longer in the presence of DMT.

plain: The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says that brain cells starved of oxygen survive longer when DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound, is present. The story connects this to a protein on cells called the sigma-1 receptor. Gallimore gives it as a laboratory finding without naming the study, and it would suggest DMT has a protective job in the brain.
